existing_interfaces.replay: Byte-identical recorded_replay.py plus original DockerSandbox, clone/ref helpers, original smoke/git checks and committed-image verification
existing_interfaces.sandbox: Standard-library Docker CLI interface; docker cp of complete pinned checkout; each action uses bash -lc
existing_interfaces.resource_evidence: Executed #29 driver already caps both bootstrap and fresh-check sandboxes at 1.5 CPU / 6 GiB
existing_interfaces.native_inline: Synthesizes from rebuild_cmds and emits metadata source agent_replay; does not replay full recorded actions
existing_interfaces.native_reference_writer: Unmodified _rewrite_dockerfile_from and _update_task_toml_reproducibility support explicit image refs and local_only/private metadata
existing_interfaces.native_distribution: No recorded-action initializer artifact is supplied by prepare_dataset_for_push; native inline/registry routes remain distinct

chosen_candidate.environment_procedure: Reconstruct bootstrap from immutable original actions, then build the unchanged original per-task overlay from that dependency
chosen_candidate.task_source: Restore original #5996 environment overlay from the verified original phase; bind it and all other inputs to original/native task identities
chosen_candidate.recipe_change: Only candidate bootstrap FROM ref and environment provenance may differ; original source/test/oracle/instruction bytes and overlay commands stay unchanged
chosen_candidate.bootstrap_ref: Use an experiment-specific local/r2e-replay dependency ref, without creating/overwriting the original shared bootstrap alias
chosen_candidate.metadata: Keep candidate image local_only/private with an explicit public initialization descriptor; no claim that the task Dockerfile alone is standalone
chosen_candidate.artifact: Public source bundle: task, original action plan, pinned source/base/dependency descriptor and initializer code; no image-layer release

justified_infrastructure_adaptations: Parameterize the existing replay driver and compose it with the already validated control/archive/cleanup lifecycle; no LLM or installation-command changes
Pin node public digest to the exact observed base image ID shared by #29 and #37

Remove the source bootstrap sandbox after committing, before fresh-image verification, so only one 1.5-CPU/6-GiB bootstrap sandbox is active; the original fresh-check function consumes only the committed image and unchanged test commands
Use a unique owned dependency ref rather than the old original-tag alias; rewrite only the declared environment ref/provenance with native source helpers
Capture effective tool/source/dependency identities using the recorded test PATH; do not invoke an absent package-manager shim to install tooling
limits: Interface assessment is source evidence, not a candidate build or new #5996 control result
Candidate generation must prove exact allowed file/metadata differences and unchanged grading contract before runtime
Public action/task bundle requires its initializer; no supported production loader or native standalone-image release is established
Dependency versions can drift; record actual image/tool/lock identities and stop on any original exit divergence
